messages.text:
The T. P2 would be ok if it would get to me faster than the BS-2. And I
understand the NerdQX was replaced and is no longer pending.

Hi Victor,

Yes, the Thor P2 is the faster of the two. It is on the shelf at our US warehouse with one set aside for you, so it goes out as soon as UPS delivers your BS-2 to us. The B.2 would have to come from the manufacturer first, which adds weeks.

So I have locked that in: your warranty replacement is a Hammer Thor P2 (10 TH/s), at no cost to you, and it releases automatically the moment your returned unit is checked in at our warehouse. You will get the tracking by email as soon as it ships.

And yes, that is right on the NerdQX. It was swapped for the BS-2 back on September 3, so nothing is pending on it.

Nothing further is needed from you, just the return on its way to us.

Victor A. — thanks for your patience with this one.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Should I send the power supply with the BS-2 or should I keep that for the
Thor P2?
Read the hammer miner thor p2 page

Hi Victor,

Keep it. Send only the miner itself, no power supply and no cables. That is all our warehouse needs for the diagnosis, and it keeps the box smaller and safer in transit.

Your Thor P2 is a brand new unit and goes out in its own packaging, so you do not need to hold anything back from the BS-2 for it. If anything is missing from the box when it lands, tell me and I will have it sent out to you.

Just make sure the return reference is written clearly on the outside of the box, and it goes out the moment your unit is checked in with us.

Thanks Victor, you are all set.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Im looking for an update for my replacement unit. The tracking number shows
my BS-2 arrived at the Chattanooga warehouse on Tuesday, Oct 20th.

Hi Victor,

Thanks for the update, and sorry you are still waiting on this one.

Here is where it stands. Your Thor P2 is sitting at our Chattanooga warehouse with your name on it, reserved and packed ready to go. It is held for one reason only: your returned BS-2 has not been booked in by our receiving team yet, and the replacement releases automatically the moment it is. Your tracking showing delivery on Tuesday the 20th is exactly what I need, so I have put that in front of the warehouse side to get the receipt logged and the hold lifted.

A colleague picks that up today at 10am ET, and you will get the answer, and the tracking for the Thor P2, by email.

Nothing more is needed from you.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Can I get some help about an RMA that I sent last week to the warehouse?
Have heard nothing after the tracking number says it was delivered.
Shop···· is the order for my replacement that was supposed to ship out
when I sent a faulty unit back.

Hi Victor,

You are right to chase this, and I am sorry. Your BS-2 reached Chattanooga on October 20 and a week later it still has not been booked in by our receiving team, which is the one thing standing between you and your replacement.

Your Thor P2 is physically there, reserved against Shop···· with your name on it. Nothing else is missing and nothing is owed. The hold on it lifts the moment the return is checked in, and I have pushed it back to the warehouse side a second time with your delivery date so it gets logged and released.

A colleague picks this up tomorrow at 10am ET, and your tracking comes to you by email as soon as it leaves.

For the runaround, I have made you a code for a future order, HD-••••••, $25 off, yours alone, valid on orders over $100.

Thanks for your patience on this one, Victor.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

That is a terrible value discount code for the amount of hassle I have had
to endure starting from when I ordered the NerdQX months ago and I still do
not have any working equipment.
